Her Question Was the Answer

Grade 12 · English · Mystery Case File

THE DIRECTIONS

You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.

The first time you press record, your computer will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.

FOUR PARTSONE ANSWER
THE SCENE

Your class is solving a mystery from 1945. The question is: how did one woman change a law? Tomorrow you give your class the final answer. You need four parts to build it. Four people each have one part.

THE HISTORY

This mystery is about Elizabeth Peratrovich and her people, the Tlingit. In 1945 she spoke to the lawmakers of Alaska. She asked for a law to treat Native people fairly. Alaska remembers her every year on February 16.
